question: Does source-visible Fr 8994 text support or challenge interpreting its IIII/k signs as the same address as F.m.IV.157 folio 8?
selection: Follow-up to E31/E32, using four larger versions of the already retained photographs. The text was inspected before this formal result was written; exploratory, not preregistered.
direct_result: The numeral-bearing capture includes a third-nocturn rubric and Nec propria salute contentus. A separate upper-margin capture shows k and Devenerat martir; another capture shows Egregius martyr Olavus. These are source-linked readings, not inferred from photograph ordinal.

catalogue_comparator.access: Official-page search indexing, rechecked 25 October; Finnish scan not inspected

folio_8.range: Within Regnante illustrissimo through the beginning of the verse Offerebat of Iustus vero

folios_9_10.range: Begins Egregius in the third nocturn and proceeds to Lawrence

catalogue_comparator.warning: The catalogue itself suggests interleaving temporale/sanctorale units. Bracketed signature components are editorially supplied; do not treat every component as read from a surviving page.

interpretation.changed_case: The apparent same-address lead is now a potential content conflict, not simple corroborating signature similarity. The local third-nocturn text differs from the catalogue's first-nocturn range at the proposed matching address.
interpretation.conditional_exclusion: If the addresses identify the same unique unrepeated location in the same service/section and both source descriptions are correct, incompatible first- versus third-nocturn text challenges the single-book attribution.
alternatives: Inferred signature components or side mapping are wrong
Different books sharing production and liturgy

identification_concordance.role: Modern performance booklet offers the same chant incipits/order. An identification aid, not a primary witness or independent target transcription; no variants or melodies imported.

access_record.outcome: Browser verification page; untouched. Official index lists PDM, a 42.31 MB whole-fragment PDF and 28 TIFF files; listing is not acquisition.
Documented open metadata route also displayed browser verification; untouched. No Finnish image acquired.

next_test: Inspect Finnish folio 8 and ff.9-10 signs and full text through ordinary legitimate access; establish the numbering units and whether labels repeat. Read the exact Taitto/Keskiaho passages before novelty claims. Fr 20278 remains an additional missing comparator.
